structured.answer: The box "להבין סוג של חיסכון" on the home page is the way in. It took me to the מדריך, where I found the "מדד S&P 500" card, but I only read the card's two lines, not a full explanation, and I can't tell if the S&P is something I open or something inside another product.

stuck.why: I read from the right and got the big 'מה השאלה שלכם' form first. The box that answers my question ('להבין סוג של חיסכון') is in the left column and I almost missed it.
Over 25 cards that look alike with no clear starting point for a beginner. I got bored scrolling.

stuck.where: מדריך, 'במה הכסף מושקע' vs 'איפה הכסף מוחזק'
stuck.why: The S&P 500 is under 'what the money is invested in', not with the savings types, so I wasn't sure what I actually open to get it.

used: Home page heading 'מקור' and 'להבין חיסכון והשקעה בישראל'
Card 'להבין סוג של חיסכון: מה זה, כמה זה עולה ואיך זה ממוסה'
מדריך heading and 'מאיפה להתחיל' (קרן השתלמות link)
skimmed: 'מה השאלה שלכם' form with goal chips and ₪ fields
Card headings under כסף שוטף וקצר, חיסכון עם הטבת מס, פרישה, לילדים, לבחירה עצמית
skipped: 'כסף שיושב בעו"ש' and 'מה כבר יש לכם' cards
Footer links and small grey text
not_found: The actual explanation page for the S&P 500 or a קרן השתלמות (I only saw the cards)
A simple 'start here if you're new' path

findings.what: The box that explains a type of saving is in the left column, after the big goal form, so someone reading from the right meets the form first and can miss it
The guide is a long wall of more than 25 similar cards with no beginner's starting point, which is overwhelming
The S&P 500 is under 'במה הכסף מושקע', not with the savings types, so it's unclear what you actually open to invest in it
Card text full of jargon (מק"מ, צמודה, חשיפה לדולר, מנוטרלת)
